summary: UroGen Pharma filed an 8-K announcing it entered into a settlement and license agreement with Teva resolving patent litigation over Jelmyto (mitomycin). Teva will receive a non-exclusive license to sell a generic version starting September 15, 2030, conditional on FDA approval. All ongoing litigation in the District of Delaware will be terminated. The agreement is subject to FTC/DOJ review. This is a routine patent settlement/licensing event, not a special situation. No deal terms or financial details are disclosed.
